method.filtering_summary: Live search at about 7:40 AM EAT on 13 sources (12 answered; ReliefWeb failed again) pulled 2,015 postings. 1,472 were older than 7 days or old reposts, 233 senior or excluded titles, 141 not target roles, 38 excluded Kenya and 43 duplicates. Of the 88 that passed, most were Jobicy bump-dated Canonical reqs or roles shown before. micro1's own portal was read directly: 23 new posts since Friday, and the three software or ML ones open worldwide lead the list as stretches; two US-only tester roles and 18 non-software specialist posts were set aside. Jobgether answered live over HTTP this time, and two close fits (dexter health and Scale Army) made the top tier. Close reads dropped LATAM- and EU-only roles, 3+ and 5+ year asks, an unpaid internship and duplicates. Nothing old was carried over.

stories.title: SpaceX closes $40 billion debt deal to buy AI chips
stories.summary: Elon Musk said SpaceX closed $40 billion of mostly callable debt to buy GPUs, with the money arriving in the first half of 2027; Bloomberg had reported it was for Nvidia chips.
stories.why: The biggest compute raise of the week sits behind Grok, so expect more Grok and xAI capacity and hiring news.

stories.title: Grok releases the first seven minutes of its AI-generated 'Odyssey'
stories.summary: Three months after Musk promised a full-length AI film, Grok published seven minutes, now billed as Episode 1 of an Odyssey series.
stories.why: A public test of how far AI video generation has come, and how critics are judging it.

stories.title: Study: forced to pick, Grok's model chooses Republicans and GPT picks Democrats
stories.summary: Researchers asked both models, through their APIs, who to vote for in nearly 500 US races; they disagreed in more than 90% of them, while the consumer apps refused to answer.
stories.why: A reminder that raw API behaviour differs from the apps, which matters when he builds products on top of these models.

stories.title: Block's new Dessa voice model runs locally and sounds eerily human
stories.summary: Block's research lab released Dessa, a full-duplex voice model that can talk and listen at once and runs on a MacBook M4 Max, with laughs and pauses built in.
stories.why: Local voice models open up agent features without paying per-minute cloud speech costs.

stories.title: Nvidia's role as AI financier faces its first big test
stories.summary: As credit tightens for neocloud partners, Nvidia's strategy of funding and backstopping customers' buildouts, including $36 billion in off-balance-sheet cloud deals as of July, is under strain.
stories.why: Funding stress at AI cloud firms can slow hiring at the infrastructure end of the market.

stories.title: Instacart reportedly explored selling itself to DoorDash or Uber
stories.summary: The Information and Bloomberg report Instacart hired a bank and held talks with DoorDash, while Uber walked away; the company is worth more than $13 billion.
stories.why: Consolidation in delivery tech, a sector with plenty of engineering roles.

stories.title: Apollo economist: AI has delivered 'zero financial payoff' to most companies
stories.summary: Torsten Slok found flat profit margins and revenue per worker across the S&P 500 minus its seven tech giants, with no sign yet that AI is lifting productivity.
stories.why: Employers are starting to ask for measurable AI results, so CV bullets with numbers stand out.

stories.title: How two critical PHP bugs almost broke the internet
stories.summary: The PHP Foundation shipped patches on Wednesday for PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), which let attackers into PHP servers without a password; big hosts got an early heads-up.
stories.why: A live example of the security patching work backend and platform teams are hiring for.

stories.title: Nairobi fintech Flowt targets a $1 million loan book for climate SMEs
stories.summary: Flowt uses AI to turn bank, M-Pesa and accounting records into lender-ready credit profiles, after a $550,000 pre-seed led by Delta40.
stories.why: Kenyan fintech building AI credit scoring, close to his loan-simulation work at Kwara.

stories.title: South Africa's Store2Door eyes Kenya with free online shops and e-scooter financing
stories.summary: Store2Door plans to enter Kenya and Nigeria in the second quarter of 2027, pairing free online stores with financed electric delivery scooters from Agilitee.
stories.why: Another commerce and payments platform heading to Nairobi, a possible future employer.

stories.title: The hidden risks in Kenya's discarded office computers
stories.summary: Business Daily looks at data-security risks and lost value in old office computers, servers and printers, noting Kenya has no reliable figures separating them from other e-waste.
stories.why: Data-handling gaps like this are where Kenyan firms need engineers who think about security.
